{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "winterrdog",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "concept ACK; asked about file permissions for cached private key, satisfied by umask explanation"
    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "concept ACK; pointed out space injection vector in ADD_ONION arguments and suggested validation"
    },
    {
      "login": "vasild",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "concept ACK; suggested strict whitelist validation for ServiceID and key payload rather than blacklisting"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:5097038039",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "Space characters in returned keys bypass CRLF checks and allow injecting ADD_ONION arguments such as Port= or Flags=Detach",
      "quote": "The space still gets through. The key goes into ADD_ONION unquoted, and in the control protocol a space is what separates arguments.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5545894123"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5545894123",
      "settled_by_quote": "Private-key format is now checked when received and before cached reuse, blocking both CRLF and space injection."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5526250741",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "Character blacklisting is brittle compared to strictly validating expected base64 characters for KeyBlob",
      "quote": "Instead of chasing bad characters from the Tor router reponses, it would be more robust to only allow legit characters and frown upon anything else.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5545894123"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5545894123",
      "settled_by_quote": "addressed all comments, thank you! ... and @vasild for suggesting strict key-format and service-ID validation."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5543733038",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "Malformed ServiceID in Tor daemon reply is passed unchecked to LookupNumeric() and LogInfo() instead of aborting",
      "quote": "But it must be exactly 56 base32 characters. If it is not, then it is safer to assume malformed reply from Tor, stop the processing right there, and not pass the malformed stuff to other functions.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5545894123"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5545894123",
      "settled_by_quote": "Service IDs are validated before caching the key or advertising the service"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3938169152",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "Cached onion private key files might not have restrictive owner-only file permissions",
      "quote": "should we explicitly enforce owner-only permissions when writing the cached onion private key ?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3958710162",
      "settled_by_quote": "ah, yes! case closed."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5087972696",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "concept ACK",
      "substantive": false
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5097038039",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Validating Tor replies and private key handling",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5526250741",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Validating replies from Tor daemon",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record. Multiple suggestions on stricter validation (jeanpablojp, vasild) were implemented in a rebase; winterrdog's query on file permissions was settled by existing umask logic."
}
